# @dxtmisha/constructor

> Class-based Vue 3 component constructors, state logic engines, and ARIA accessibility controllers for the DXT UI design system.

`@dxtmisha/constructor` decouples component architecture into pure TypeScript classes that encapsulate component lifecycles, ARIA accessibility, focus management, form validation, dynamic BEM modifier calculation, and event handling.

## Core Constructors & Modules

- [Button](src/constructors/Button): Button constructor managing loading states, icons, palettes, and ARIA button roles.
- [Field](src/constructors/Field): Input field container coordinating floating labels, validation states, character counters, and messages.
- [Input](src/constructors/Input): Headless text input constructor with mask handling, prefix/suffix icons, and clear actions.
- [Select](src/constructors/Select): Dropdown select constructor with keyboard navigation, value mapping, and menu binding.
- [Table](src/constructors/Table): Data table controller coordinating column headers, sorting, pagination, and sticky headers.
- [Modal](src/constructors/Modal): Modal overlay controller with focus trap, ESC key handling, backdrop management, and scroll lock.
- [List](src/constructors/List): List and item selection engine with keyboard navigation and grouping.
- [Menu](src/constructors/Menu): Menu and popup navigation constructor with positioning and keyboard traversal.
- [Checkbox](src/constructors/Checkbox): Accessible checkbox and multi-value checkbox group controller.
- [Radio](src/constructors/Radio): Accessible radio button and radio group state engine.
- [Switch](src/constructors/Switch): Accessible toggle switch controller.
- [Tabs](src/constructors/Tabs): Accessible tablist and tab navigation controller.
- [Window](src/constructors/Window): Floating window and popup anchor positioning controller.
